observations: Game D3D12 event streams pause for about 423 ms; kernel graphics events continue.
A game-device paging packet spans that pause and completes about 1 ms before the native projection returns.
A 256-byte default-heap buffer creation is recorded near the start of the pause; this is not proof that the buffer caused it.
No selected ShaderCache or CreatePipelineStateObject events appear in the exported window. This does not exclude shader work.
limits: Diagnostic tracing can perturb timing. Untraced native outliers independently reproduced.
No CPU context-switch stacks or GPU command-duration attribution; the underlying wait dependency and driver/engine cause remain unknown.
VidMmOpType numeric value is preserved without assigning an undocumented meaning.
Zero ExecutionTime100ns is the recorded field, not proof of zero GPU work.
System-wide ETL stays local. Export includes game-owned events and correlated paging completion only; addresses removed.
